subject: FB-3: KB-inject driver (export-kb → AGENTS.md)
description: Build the KB injection path for the two ON arms. Steps: (1) onboard each unique fast-split repo at its pinned commit via scripts/onboard-loop.js; (2) scripts/export-kb.js → write the KB block to AGENTS.md in the repo context the scaffold loads; (3) wire two arms — ON-plain (cold-start KB only) and ON-self-learning (onboard-loop with --judge before export). Reuse existing export-kb.js/onboard-loop.js (already proven on a foreign repo). Success: a fast-split instance runs with KB present in AGENTS.md for both ON arms. Depends on FB-2.
